Code scanning merge protection with the code_scanning rule (tool CodeQL), available at the repository level

Required flow control on main (protected branch, required checks, no bypass)

The first human command sets it, and infra/README.md (Repository settings) says so. Without it, criterion 4 cannot be met.

No Dependabot configuration exists. If one is added, its pull requests get Dependabot secrets only, so FORBIDDEN_TERMS must also be set with --app dependabot or their ci-passed fails (fail closed, as intended).
